unit.why: A short memorate. The rebbe of Rozla sees his late master R. Zvi after his death and talks with him, and the book's master draws a conclusion from the account.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of sayings and accounts about the master; (יח) before it is a saying, and (כ) after it is a separate story.

stories.start_quote: וכמו כן נשמע ממנו ברבים פ"א
stories.end_quote: ואעמידם על מכונם כ״ז שאני בעוה״ז
stories.summary_en: The master tells how the rebbe of Rozla saw his late master and father-in-law R. Zvi, who said he would not enter his place in upper Paradise until he had repaired all his followers; the master resolves to repair his own followers while still alive instead.
